workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from repo references (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro) -> Meshy multi-image-to-3d (latest, quad remesh, PBR)

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z

concepts.prompt: Slender aviary gate tower, 18 metres tall, square-to-octagonal pale limestone shaft with string courses, pointed-arch windows with warm glass, an open belfry level near the top, and a steep conical slate-blue roof with a gold finial. A royal-blue banner with a pale wing emblem and gold trim hangs on the shaft. Matches the gate towers in the front gate reference. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no cast background, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) with clearly stacked horizontal sedimentary strata and soft moss on the ledges; where present, slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66), honey-coloured timber, cream plaster, royal-blue banner fabric with a small gold accent. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat ground contact at the base.

visual_verdict: Strong: slender octagonal limestone shaft, timber belfry, conical slate roof and gold finial, blue banner; 18 m tall, 4.7 m wide.
integration_flag: OFF - candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: no red/oxblood requested or observed; blue banners/roofs only
